summary.en: UK bands re-export American blues louder; albums and studio craft take over singles.
summary.zh: 英国乐队把美国蓝调更大声寄回；专辑与录音室工艺压过单曲。

sound.en: Rickenbacker jangle, Marshall stacks, four-track then eight-track studios
sound.zh: Rickenbacker 叮当声、Marshall 音箱墙、四轨到八轨录音室

body.en:
Liverpool and London do not invent electric rock; they industrialize it. From 1964 the Beatles move from hit singles to full albums and multi-track studio work. The Rolling Stones keep Chicago blues covers and swagger on the charts. The Who smash gear on stage and write power-chord anthems. Hendrix, in London from 1966, pushes feedback, wah, and controlled noise into mainstream sets.

By 1969 the working model is clear: self-contained band, album as primary product, touring as spectacle.
body.zh:
利物浦与伦敦没有发明电声摇滚；他们把它产业化。从 1964 年起，Beatles 从热单转向整张专辑与多轨录音。Rolling Stones 把芝加哥蓝调翻唱与姿态送上榜单。The Who 在台上砸器材，写强力和弦歌曲。Hendrix 1966 年起常驻伦敦，把反馈、哇音与可控噪音推进主流现场。

到 1969 年，工作模型已经清楚：自足乐队、专辑为主要产品、巡演为大型演出。
